Class MessageListCommand

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.chat.cmd.MessageListCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Command
public class MessageListCommand extends Object implements Command
The MessageListCommand type is the message list command. The alias is messages. The command prints this session's history. An optional filter keeps all, user, assistant, or system. The word verbose prints full text. The word meta prints the stored locator beside each message.

    • execute

      public void execute(CommandContext ctx, String args) throws Exception
      The execute method prints the session history. parseFlags(String) reads meta, verbose, and the optional filter. previewCap(CommandContext, boolean) chooses how many characters of each message to show. If meta is set, the method walks sequence numbers from one through the message count. A null inspect result is skipped. A filter that does not match the stored role is skipped. Each meta hit writes the sequence number, the role, the head mark, id=, the Roux id or 0 0, page=, the page id, and the residency. The next line is the text cut by truncate(String, int). If meta is not set, the method walks ChatSession.getMessages(). A filter that does not match the message type is skipped. Each hit writes the one-based index, the type name, and the head mark, then the cut text. If no row is shown, the method writes No messages. Each line ends with a carriage return and a line feed.
      Specified by:
      execute in interface Command
      Parameters:
      ctx - The shell resources for this connection.
      args - The remainder of the line after the command name.
      Throws:
      Exception - The filter word is not recognized.

    • previewCap

      static int previewCap(CommandContext ctx, boolean verbose)
      The previewCap method chooses how many characters of a message to print. If verbose is true, the method returns 0, which means no cut. Otherwise the method reads list-preview-chars from the chat properties. If that value is negative, the method returns 120.
      Parameters:
      ctx - The shell resources for this connection.
      verbose - true when the caller asked for full text.
      Returns:
      The character cap, or 0 when the text should not be cut.

    • truncate

      static String truncate(String text, int cap)
      The truncate method shortens text to a character cap. A null text becomes the empty string. If cap is 0 or negative, the text is returned unchanged. If the text is no longer than the cap, the text is returned unchanged. Otherwise the method returns the first cap characters plus the ellipsis character.
      Parameters:
      text - The raw message text.
      cap - The maximum number of characters, or 0 when the text should not be cut.
      Returns:
      The original text, or the cut text with an ellipsis.

    • roleMatches

      private boolean roleMatches(byte role, org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.MessageType filter)
      The roleMatches method compares a stored Roux role with a Spring message type. Roux is the store that holds the conversation messages. MessageType.SYSTEM matches Role.SYSTEM. MessageType.USER matches Role.USER. MessageType.ASSISTANT matches Role.ASSISTANT. Any other filter matches every role.
      Parameters:
      role - The stored Roux role byte.
      filter - The Spring message type selected by the caller.
      Returns:
      true when the role matches the filter.

    • parseFlags

      private MessageListCommand.Flags parseFlags(String args) throws Exception
      The parseFlags method reads meta, verbose, and the filter from the remainder. A null remainder is treated as empty. The words meta and verbose may appear in either order, each as a whole token. The leftover text is passed to parseFilter(String).
      Parameters:
      args - The remainder of the line after the command name.
      Returns:
      The parsed MessageListCommand.Flags.
      Throws:
      Exception - The leftover filter word is not recognized.

    • parseFilter

      private org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.MessageType parseFilter(String args) throws Exception
      The parseFilter method turns the leftover text into a message type. A null value, an empty value, or all returns null, which keeps every message. The word user returns MessageType.USER. The word assistant returns MessageType.ASSISTANT. The word system returns MessageType.SYSTEM. Any other word throws Exception with Unknown filter: , the word, and (use all, user, assistant, system).
      Parameters:
      args - The leftover filter token.
      Returns:
      The type to keep, or null when every type is kept.
      Throws:
      Exception - The filter word is not recognized.
